note: The lexer starts scanning an input-controlled identifier/keyword from the current input position.
The scan stops only when a byte is not treated as a letter/digit; the safety obligation is that every byte classification and resulting scan stay within the intended token boundary.
The computed token length is derived from the scan endpoint and carries the input-controlled extent forward.
The lexer copies the scanned token bytes into a heap buffer for keyword interning; if the length is incorrect, this becomes the overflowing copy.
